title: Mine was warped.
text: Mine was warped.. My pan arrived but got put away so, I didn't use it for a while. I have a smoothtop cooking surface (not gas) and the pan would twirl because it never sat flat. It was warped from day one. After using it a couple of times with nothing but frustration, we threw it away.
